--- title: "Statistical analysis" subtitle: "Mobbing responses of tropical passerines to sympatric and allopatric owl vocalizations" author: "Marcelo Araya-Salas" date: "2026-11-15" toc: true toc-depth: 2 toc-location: left number-sections: true highlight-style: pygments format: html: df-print: kable code-fold: true code-tools: true css: qmd.css editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(brms) library(emmeans) library(loo) library(ggplot2) library(bayesplot) library(viridis) library(kableExtra) }) dir.create("output/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE) dir.create("data/processed/models", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE) stim_cols <- setNames(mako(10)[c(3, 5, 7, 9)], c("Sympatric", "Allopatric", "Allopatric+", "Control")) ``` ::: # Data Each row is a playback trial. `INDIVIDUOS` is the number of responding birds (response records) and `MORFOESPECIE` the number of responding species and morphospecies. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d <- read.csv("data/raw/data_v2.csv", na.strings = "NA", check.names = FALSE) names(d) <- trimws(names(d)) d$year <- factor(substr(d$FECHA, 7, 10)) d$stimulus <- factor(d$ESTIMULO, levels = c("GLCR", "GLBR", "GLEU", "BADE"), labels = c("Sympatric", "Allopatric", "Allopatric+", "Control")) # Sampling site: point number within team transect. Team 3 (18 Jan 2024) # revisited team-2 point 19; 2026 points 1-4 revisited team-1 points 1-4. team <- ifelse(d$EQUIPO == 3, 2, d$EQUIPO) d$site <- factor(paste0("T", team, "_P", d$PUNTO)) ``` ::: - Stimuli: *Glaucidium costaricanum* (sympatric, GLCR), *G. brasilianum* (allopatric with range overlap elsewhere, GLBR), *G. passerinum* (strictly allopatric, GLEU) and *Basileuterus delattrii* (non-predator control, BADE) - 49 trials at 31 sites (41 in 2024, 8 in 2026) - 63 response records; 41% of trials had at least one response ## Sampling design ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} kbl(table(Stimulus = d$stimulus, Year = d$year), caption = "Trials per stimulus and year") |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
Trials per stimulus and year
2024 2026
Sympatric 10 2
Allopatric 11 2
Allopatric+ 10 2
Control 10 2
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kbl(as.data.frame(table(table(d$site))), col.names = c("Trials per site", "Number of sites"), caption = "Number of trials per site") |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
Number of trials per site
Trials per site Number of sites
1 21
2 6
4 4
````` ::: ::: ## Responses by stimulus ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} agg <- aggregate(cbind(Trials = 1, `Trials with response` = INDIVIDUOS > 0, `Responding birds` = INDIVIDUOS, `Responding species` = MORFOESPECIE) ~ stimulus, data = d, FUN = sum) kbl(agg, col.names = c("Stimulus", names(agg)[-1])) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
Stimulus Trials Trials with response Responding birds Responding species
Sympatric 12 9 42 26
Allopatric 13 6 11 8
Allopatric+ 12 5 10 9
Control 12 0 0 0
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat("Proportion of zeros:", round(mean(d$INDIVIDUOS == 0), 2), "| mean:", round(mean(d$INDIVIDUOS), 2), "| variance:", round(var(d$INDIVIDUOS), 2)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Proportion of zeros: 0.59 | mean: 1.29 | variance: 6.08 ``` ::: ::: # Statistical models Each response was modeled with a Bayesian generalized linear mixed model with stimulus and year as fixed effects and site as a random intercept. Poisson and negative binomial distributions (log link) were compared. Fixed effects had `normal(0, 6)` priors; the intercept and site standard deviation used brms defaults. Each model was run with 4 chains of 10,000 iterations (5,000 warm-up). Models are cached in `data/processed/models/`. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} iter <- 10000 warmup <- 5000 chains <- 4 pri <- c(prior(normal(0, 6), class = "b")) ctrl <- list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15) fit <- function(resp, fam, prior = pri, name) { # negative binomial with non-overdispersed counts lets the shape parameter # drift to infinity, which is very slow: use init = 0 and a lighter control is_nb <- fam$family == "negbinomial" f <- bf(as.formula(paste(resp, "~ stimulus + year + (1 | site)"))) brm(f, family = fam, data = d, prior = prior, iter = iter, warmup = warmup, chains = chains, cores = chains, seed = 123, control = if (is_nb) list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12) else ctrl, init = if (is_nb) 0 else "random", file = file.path("data/processed/models", name), file_refit = "on_change") } responses <- c(INDIVIDUOS = "Number of responding birds", MORFOESPECIE = "Number of responding species") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mods <- list() for (resp in names(responses)) { mods[[resp]] <- list( pois = fit(resp, poisson(), name = paste0(resp, "_pois")), nb = fit(resp, negbinomial(), name = paste0(resp, "_nb")), prior2 = fit(resp, poisson(), prior = set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b"), name = paste0(resp, "_pois_prior2")), prior10 = fit(resp, poisson(), prior = set_prior("normal(0, 10)", class = "b"), name = paste0(resp, "_pois_prior10")) ) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} coef_table <- function(m) { s <- summary(m) out <- rbind(s$fixed, s$random$site) out <- out[, c("Estimate", "l-95% CI", "u-95% CI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")] rownames(out)[nrow(out)] <- "sd(site)" out } contrast_table <- function(m) { out <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m, pairwise ~ stimulus)$contrasts) out$`response ratio` <- exp(out$estimate) out$credible <- out$lower.HPD > 0 | out$upper.HPD < 0 out } print_contrasts <- function(x) { kbl(x[, c("contrast", "estimate", "lower.HPD", "upper.HPD", "response ratio")], digits = 3, col.names = c("Contrast", "Estimate (log)", "95% HPD lower", "95% HPD upper", "Response ratio"), row.names = FALSE) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) |> row_spec(which(x$credible), bold = TRUE) } ``` ::: ::: {.callout-note} Contrasts are posterior medians and 95% highest posterior density intervals (HPD) on the log scale, averaged over years. Contrasts in **bold** have 95% HPD that exclude zero. Response ratios are exponentiated contrasts. ::: ```{.r .cell-code} for (resp in names(responses)) { m <- mods[[resp]] cat("\n\n## ", responses[resp], "\n\n") cat("\n\n### Poisson model coefficients\n\n") print(kbl(coef_table(m$pois), digits = 3) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)) cat("\n\n### Pairwise contrasts\n\n") print(print_contrasts(contrast_table(m$pois))) cat("\n\n### Poisson vs. negative binomial\n\n") lp <- loo(m$pois) ln <- loo(m$nb) lc <- loo_compare(lp, ln) lc <- data.frame(Model = c("Poisson", "Negative binomial")[as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", rownames(lc)))], `ELPD difference` = lc[, "elpd_diff"], SE = lc[, "se_diff"], check.names = FALSE) print(kbl(lc, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)) cat("\n\nPosterior predictive p-values, P[T(yrep) >= T(y)]:\n\n") y <- d[[resp]] ppp <- sapply(list(Poisson = m$pois, `Negative binomial` = m$nb), function(x) { yrep <- posterior_predict(x) c(`Proportion of zeros` = mean(rowMeans(yrep == 0) >= mean(y == 0)), Mean = mean(rowMeans(yrep) >= mean(y)), Variance = mean(apply(yrep, 1, var) >= var(y)), Maximum = mean(apply(yrep, 1, max) >= max(y))) }) print(kbl(ppp, digits = 3) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)) cat("\n\nNegative binomial contrasts:\n\n") print(print_contrasts(contrast_table(m$nb))) cat("\n\n### Prior sensitivity\n\n") sens <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(`normal(0, 2)` = "prior2", `normal(0, 6)` = "pois", `normal(0, 10)` = "prior10"), function(p) { x <- contrast_table(m[[p]]) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", x$estimate, x$lower.HPD, x$upper.HPD) })) colnames(sens) <- contrast_table(m$pois)$contrast print(kbl(t(sens), caption = "Contrast estimates (log scale) and 95% HPD under three priors on the fixed effects") |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)) } ``` ## Number of responding birds ### Poisson model coefficients

predictive checks-2.png){width=1500} ::: ::: # Figures Letters are assigned from the pairwise contrasts of the Poisson models: stimuli sharing a letter did not differ credibly. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # compact letter display from the credible contrasts cld <- function(ct, lv = levels(d$stimulus)) { diff <- matrix(FALSE, length(lv), length(lv), dimnames = list(lv, lv)) pr <- strsplit(gsub("[()]", "", ct$contrast), " - ") for (i in seq_along(pr)) diff[pr[[i]][1], pr[[i]][2]] <- diff[pr[[i]][2], pr[[i]][1]] <- ct$credible[i] groups <- list() for (s in lv) { placed <- FALSE for (g in seq_along(groups)) if (!any(diff[s, groups[[g]]])) { groups[[g]] <- c(groups[[g]], s); placed <- TRUE } if (!placed) groups[[length(groups) + 1]] <- s } sapply(lv, function(s) paste(letters[which(sapply(groups, function(g) s %in% g))], collapse = "")) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_files <- c(INDIVIDUOS = "fig3_responding_birds_by_stimulus.png", MORFOESPECIE = "fig4_responding_species_by_stimulus.png") for (resp in names(responses)) { lt <- cld(contrast_table(mods[[resp]]$pois)) lab <- data.frame(stimulus = names(lt), label = lt, y = max(d[[resp]]) * 1.08) p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = stimulus, y = .data[[resp]], fill = stimulus)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) + geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.1, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) + geom_text(data = lab, aes(y = y, label = label), size = 6) + scale_fill_manual(values = stim_cols, guide = "none") + labs(x = "Stimulus", y = responses[resp]) + theme_classic(base_size = 18) ggsave(file.path("output/figures", fig_files[resp]), p, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300) print(p) } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
